title: Benefit Accounting Desk Entry — Loading the Yearly RideLink Value-Added Allotment
content:
Each benefit year, the calendar year, a Non-Emergency Medical Transportation benefit on a level that carries value-added trips receives its allotment of value-added one-way trips, booked as the year's allotment load entry on the member's value-added trip ledger.

## Rule

The allotment load entry of a benefit year is booked once, for the current benefit year, and records that year and the trips loaded. On January 1 each benefit year's value-added allotment of one-way trips to the level's value-added destinations, within the level's value-added trip distance, is loaded.

A benefit year's value-added allotment is not loaded until the ledger carries the expiry entry for the previous benefit year's unused trips, whenever that year leaves trips to expire. Said another way: where the previous benefit year leaves trips to expire and the ledger does not yet carry its expiry entry, the current year's allotment is not loaded.

**Effect.** The allotment load entry stands on the value-added trip ledger for the year, and the member can use the loaded trips for value-added rides to the level's destinations. The member sees the load, its year and its trip count in their value-added trip history.

## The loading tool

The entry is booked with `load_year_allotment_a6239ac8`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`. One call adds one allotment load entry, dated today; nothing else on the benefit changes.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ride_benefit_id` | Reference number of the member's transportation benefit, as the transportation benefit lookup returns it for the verified member | Identifier |
| `benefit_year` | The benefit year the trips are loaded for | YYYY, a four-digit calendar year with no month or day |
| `trips` | The number of trips loaded | Whole number of one-way trips, positive, no decimals |

**Return.** A text dictionary: `status` is the literal "loaded" when the entry was posted, which is the success receipt; `ledger_entry` is the reference of the new allotment entry; `benefit_year` echoes the year as YYYY; `trips` is the integer number of trips loaded; `posted_date` is today's date as YYYY-MM-DD.
